title: How Do You Keep Your Phone and Camera Safe on a Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: Use a wrist strap or lanyard when it is out, a waterproof pouch or dry bag when it is not, and keep it away from the bow at speed. Waterproof is not safe.
heroAlt: A phone in a clear waterproof pouch on a lanyard, resting on a grey boat cushion
